title: 1792: The Lotus Throne — mission development cards

scope.meaning: These cards define the next development increment for inventoried prototypes. They do not add playable sequences or certify their new features as implemented.
scope.status_policy: development_status refers to the proposed increment only. baseline describes the ledger snapshot. implementation_receipt stays null until the increment has a concrete reviewed revision and verification.
scope.count_policy: Child beats, alternate approaches, presentations, mechanics and source retellings are not extra missions. The 28-entry youth slate includes one implemented adaptation alias and 27 planned entries.
scope.history_policy: Keep legends, miracles, conflicting allegations and dramatic invention. Preserve the ledger’s historical basis beside every card. Player choice may alter local care, communication or immediate outcomes without silently proving an allegation or overwriting a declared fixed historical endpoint.
scope.cinematic_policy: Build cinema from playable approach, staging, sound, performance and consequential action. A proposed cinematic moment is not a claim that cinematics, voice, animation or finished art already exist.
scope.verification_policy: The original authoring pass checked card coverage and consistency. Runtime increments record targeted local checks in their current_pass guides; the other draft branches have not all been freshly played or integrated.
scope.narrative_direction_policy: All narrative_direction blocks retain original planned literary, staging and attention directions. Their acceptance statements are intended review conditions, not test receipts. Current runtime work develops HOME-013/014 and retains earlier HOME-001–012 increments. current_pass records the implemented subset and limits. Other prototype branches need explicit integration; this adds no sequences.
scope.attention_policy: Prioritize the next meaningful action, protect imminent threat cues, reduce repeated prose, and leave recoverable quiet intervals. Never force attention with hidden failure timers, disable player control for a camera composition, or treat continued play time as evidence of narrative quality. Persistent objectives and reviewable information remain available.

cards.title: Learning the yard

baseline.implementation: Implemented prototype on the recorded revision.
baseline.launch: Run game/project.godot; choose Home territory.

cards.dramatic_question: Can a child find his own bearings in a household already full of adult purposes?
cards.playable_objective: Walk the yard, turn deliberately toward its landmarks, and find the courier without losing control of movement.
cards.encounter_or_choice: Choose the first landmark to inspect; the lead-in makes the message a discoverable interruption rather than another unrelated instruction.
cards.local_consequence: The next objective names the courier and where to find him; exploration creates no hidden literacy or political knowledge.
cards.cinematic_moment: Hooves, work and voices establish ordinary household life before a waiting courier cuts across it.
cards.next_implementation_task: Improve the orientation lead-in, landmark staging and objective text that hands the player into HOME-002.
cards.acceptance_criterion: A fresh start explains walk and look, completion leads visibly to the courier, and pausing or repeating an interaction cannot skip the message lesson.
cards.historical_basis: Original authored gameplay; historical setting does not authenticate the episode.

current_pass.limits: Textual staging and prototype actors; cinematic animation, voice and final art remain planned.

narrative_direction.dramatic_question: Can a child find his own bearings in a household already full of adult purposes?
narrative_direction.dramatic_turn: The yard begins as a place to wander; noticing someone waiting turns familiar space into a first responsibility.
narrative_direction.setup_payoff: Establish the courtyard threshold as home before later departures and the ambush make reaching it matter.
narrative_direction.playable_staging: Let the courier wait against a clear stretch of wall. Work and movement provide depth, while one open approach makes the waiting figure legible without taking the camera.
narrative_direction.attention_pattern: Broad exploration narrows to one human interruption. Introduce walk and look before the courier prompt; avoid displaying every later control at once.
narrative_direction.recovery: After the player finds the courier, give a short unhurried approach with no repeated summons.
narrative_direction.agency: The player chooses their path and when to approach. Looking elsewhere is permitted, and orientation help remains recallable.
narrative_direction.acceptance: A fresh player can describe where Home ends and point to the courier; idle exploration causes no repeated caption stream or skipped lesson.

cards.title: The sealed message

baseline.implementation: Implemented prototype on the recorded revision.
baseline.launch: Run game/project.godot; choose Home territory.

cards.dramatic_question: What does a future ruler do when the words of an order and the account of its bearer leave uncertainty?
cards.playable_objective: Receive the sealed message, hear courier and steward, and decide how to take the uncertain account to the trainer.
cards.encounter_or_choice: After both initial accounts, ask the steward to proceed directly to the trainer or first return to the courier for clarification; existing training stays available.
cards.local_consequence: The journal keeps the selected approach, any clarification actually heard, and the trainer’s receipt; neither path discovers a hidden culprit or grants a risk modifier.
cards.cinematic_moment: The seal remains visible in the child’s hand while an older voice supplies its meaning; the reply is the child’s first deliberate public decision.
cards.next_implementation_task: Add the optional post-reading conversation, clarification interaction, trainer acknowledgment, remembered receipt and matching objective cues.
cards.acceptance_criterion: Both approaches can reach their trainer acknowledgment, clarification is credited only after hearing it, repeat interactions do not duplicate receipts, and normal riding progression remains available.
cards.historical_basis: Original authored gameplay; historical setting does not authenticate the episode.

current_pass.limits: Textual staging and prototype actors; cinematic animation, voice and final art remain planned.

narrative_direction.dramatic_question: What does a future ruler do when the words of an order and the account of its bearer leave uncertainty?
narrative_direction.dramatic_turn: A seemingly simple delivery becomes a choice about how honestly to carry uncertainty.
narrative_direction.setup_payoff: The seal promises authority; the courier’s limited sight undercuts certainty. The trainer later acknowledges exactly the account the player chose to give.
narrative_direction.playable_staging: Keep bearer, steward and trainer in distinct working places so clarification has a physical cost and the return approach feels intentional.
narrative_direction.attention_pattern: Present the message, then the gap in the account, then the optional choice. Allow one speaker at a time rather than revealing all branches in advance.
narrative_direction.recovery: Close the trainer exchange on one acknowledgment and return to walking; do not immediately stack a second political explanation.
narrative_direction.agency: Proceed directly or return for clarification. Neither path is presented as a secretly correct test of intelligence.
narrative_direction.acceptance: A player can distinguish the two available approaches and recall what the courier actually saw; the trainer’s wording matches received information and stays reviewable.

cards.playable_objective: Mount, pass the three gates in order, brake, and dismount on clear ground.
cards.encounter_or_choice: A trainer calls for a controlled approach to the last gate; the player can slow early or recover after overshooting.
cards.local_consequence: Feedback distinguishes missing a gate from losing control and returns the rider to the unfinished part without awarding an advanced horsecraft flag.
cards.cinematic_moment: The courtyard opens into a longer sightline as the horse accelerates, then the last gate tightens the composition around a deliberate stop.
cards.next_implementation_task: Stage a readable entry and stopping area, add contextual trainer reactions, and make the next valid gate apparent from horseback.
cards.acceptance_criterion: A first-time player can identify the next gate and stopping requirement; wrong-order passage cannot complete the course and a safe retry preserves completed gates.

narrative_direction.dramatic_question: Can the child turn confidence into control when the horse has momentum of its own?
narrative_direction.dramatic_turn: Acceleration feels like mastery until the final gate asks for restraint; a controlled stop completes the emotional as well as physical lesson.
narrative_direction.setup_payoff: The pale stitch on completed gates records effort. The final stopping patch introduces making space, a skill echoed in retreat from the later attack.
narrative_direction.playable_staging: Expose the next numbered gate along the riding line; place the stopping patch beyond the last gate with room for a visible correction.
narrative_direction.attention_pattern: Use one movement cue before mounting, a brief response after each true gate passage, and silence while the player steers. Suppress unrelated household reminders during the run.
narrative_direction.recovery: Allow an unscored settling pause after the stop. An overshoot receives one actionable correction and keeps already-earned progress.
narrative_direction.agency: The rider controls speed and retry line; cinematic framing never pulls the camera off the next gate.
narrative_direction.acceptance: During a full-speed attempt the next gate and braking instruction remain legible without competing captions; a wrong-order pass cannot trigger praise or advance the sequence.

cards.title: Guard and counter

cards.dramatic_question: Will the child strike in anger or wait for the opening his teacher has exposed?
cards.playable_objective: Read two telegraphed blows, hold guard, recover and counter within the trainer’s opening.
cards.encounter_or_choice: Early swings meet a guarded response; a patient counter produces a clear change in the trainer’s stance.
cards.local_consequence: The lesson records one learned sequence and gives specific corrective feedback without practice damage or an arbitrary damage upgrade.
cards.cinematic_moment: The sound of the yard falls behind the rhythm of two practice blows; the teacher briefly lowers his weapon after a clean counter.
cards.next_implementation_task: Give each practice phase distinct posture, caption and sound cues, with recovery feedback tied to the actual strike window.
cards.acceptance_criterion: Early, late and correctly timed counters receive distinct feedback; the lesson finishes only after the required guards and counter, with no damage in practice.
cards.historical_basis: Original authored gameplay; historical setting does not authenticate the episode.

current_pass.limits: Procedural staging and original text; final animation, voice and cinematic art remain future work.

attention_increment.behavior: Short combat cues; readable priority for immediate actions; look-first-then-answer motif carries into tracking.
attention_increment.verification: Focused native caption, scene, HUD and trace suites; inherited childhood arc, aftermath, courtyard, beginning and staging checks; native presentation inspection. See guide and PR #82 for exact results and limits.

narrative_direction.dramatic_question: Will the child strike in anger or wait for the opening his teacher has exposed?
narrative_direction.dramatic_turn: The urge to answer each blow immediately gives way to recognizing a deliberate opening.
narrative_direction.setup_payoff: The teacher’s raised weapon sets an expectation that the later assailant’s tell recalls; the resemblance helps action without implying identical timing or intent.
narrative_direction.playable_staging: Keep the weapon silhouette separate from the trainer’s torso and background. A visible recovery posture supplies the counter opportunity.
narrative_direction.attention_pattern: Build a readable rhythm of preparation, guard, recovery and counter. Corrective feedback survives long enough to read, while an incoming blow’s cue takes precedence.
narrative_direction.recovery: After a clean counter, lower the weapon and leave a brief still interval before the next objective. Failed timing invites another cycle without humiliation.
narrative_direction.agency: The player may wait and observe complete cycles, attempt early, or recover after a miss; no forced camera cut supplies the answer.
narrative_direction.acceptance: Early, late and unfaced responses remain distinct, an imminent strike stays readable, and the final success reaction occurs once after the admitted counter.

cards.dramatic_question: Can observation overcome the urge to hurry toward a prize?
cards.playable_objective: Follow three physical traces and quietly reach an observation position beside the quarry.
cards.encounter_or_choice: A tempting direct line passes the later trace but cannot replace examining the earlier evidence; noisy approach calls for a calmer second attempt.
cards.local_consequence: The remembered trail contains only examined traces; completion records observation of the animal, not a kill or harvested item.
cards.cinematic_moment: Reeds and dry scrub part just enough for a first distant glimpse; the final approach holds on the animal’s breathing and the player’s footsteps.
cards.next_implementation_task: Make the three traces visually distinct, use terrain to connect their sightlines, and replace generic guidance with evidence-specific observations.
cards.acceptance_criterion: Each trace requires proximity and eye-level visibility, out-of-order inspection explains what is missing, and the final approach cannot complete through a wall or while rushing.

attention_increment.behavior: Timed observations yield quiet; original quarry reaction; two exact dressing overlaps cleared with restrained ground contrast.
attention_increment.verification: Focused native caption, scene, HUD and trace suites; inherited childhood arc, aftermath, courtyard, beginning and staging checks; native presentation inspection. See guide and PR #82 for exact results and limits.

narrative_direction.dramatic_question: Can observation overcome the urge to hurry toward a prize?
narrative_direction.dramatic_turn: The promised reward shifts from catching an animal to noticing how little evidence can disclose.
narrative_direction.setup_payoff: Shallow prints, bent reeds and pressed grass change from surface details into a sequence of movement. The final breathing animal resolves the trail without a kill.
narrative_direction.playable_staging: Compose each trace from a different silhouette and viewing height; vegetation should guide the next search area while leaving the evidence itself unobscured.
narrative_direction.attention_pattern: Repeat search, inspect, understand with longer quiet gaps between discoveries. Reserve the largest visual reveal for the quarry rather than spending it on markers.
narrative_direction.recovery: After the animal is observed, permit a still moment with optional looking before the return objective; approaching too loudly offers a readable reset.
narrative_direction.agency: The player chooses the route between traces and when to stop. Focus may assist finding a trace but cannot substitute for physical inspection.
narrative_direction.acceptance: A playtester can name all three observations in order, find the quarry without a caption obscuring it, and retry a noisy approach without duplicate memories.

cards.title: The return-path ambush

baseline.implementation: Implemented prototype on the recorded revision.

cards.dramatic_question: Can the child bring his lessons to bear when the return home becomes dangerous?
cards.playable_objective: Recognize the ambush, create space by movement or a guarded counter, and reach the courtyard alive.
cards.encounter_or_choice: Escape immediately or face the attacker long enough to open a safer retreat; mounted escape remains a supported route.
cards.local_consequence: The aftermath receives only the assault details the player actually observed; reaching safety does not identify the attacker’s employer.
cards.cinematic_moment: The familiar return bend suddenly conceals movement; the courtyard’s light becomes a practical destination while footsteps close behind.
cards.next_implementation_task: Rework the bend’s approach and escape sightline, give the assailant an unmistakable warning tell, and stage the household’s arrival response.
cards.acceptance_criterion: Both immediate escape and guard-counter retreat are viable, failed attempts restart the encounter without corrupting the household state, and unseen identity information is never added.
cards.historical_basis: Original authored gameplay; historical setting does not authenticate the episode.

current_pass.limits: Procedural staging and original text; final animation, voice and cinematic art remain future work.

attention_increment.behavior: Threat preempts queued incidental speech; physical return clears combat captions and reframes the household gate.
attention_increment.verification: Focused native caption, scene, HUD and trace suites; inherited childhood arc, aftermath, courtyard, beginning and staging checks; native presentation inspection. See guide and PR #82 for exact results and limits.

narrative_direction.dramatic_question: Can the child bring his lessons to bear when the return home becomes dangerous?
narrative_direction.dramatic_turn: A route already learned as safe becomes threatening, and the lesson’s value changes from performance to survival.
narrative_direction.setup_payoff: The familiar bend conceals a changed presence. The courtyard threshold established at the opening becomes a concrete escape destination.
narrative_direction.playable_staging: Retain recognizable return landmarks, reveal the attacker’s preparatory movement against open space, and preserve a readable route toward Home.
narrative_direction.attention_pattern: Let a brief quiet approach precede the warning. During pursuit, threat and escape information outrank reflective prose; save interpretation for safety.
narrative_direction.recovery: Crossing into safety releases the immediate threat before household dialogue begins. Avoid replacing pursuit with a long compulsory explanation at the gate.
narrative_direction.agency: Escape, counter to create space, or use the supported mounted route. The moment does not require fighting simply to see the next scene.
narrative_direction.acceptance: Every supported retreat route receives a usable warning and unobstructed escape cue; unseen attacker details never appear in the later account, and post-escape dialogue cannot restart danger.

cards.title: The household inquiry

cards.dramatic_question: Who gets to shape the account of an attack before the child has understood it himself?
cards.playable_objective: Hear the household accounts, choose escort or independent inquiry, inspect the bend and return a bounded report.
cards.encounter_or_choice: Raj Kaur’s offer makes protection useful but socially visible; investigating alone changes the exchange and presence at the bend.
cards.local_consequence: The report retains chosen approach and inspected evidence, while uncertainty survives both routes and neither produces a culprit.
cards.cinematic_moment: The same bend is quieter on the return visit; a guard’s presence, or its absence, changes the distance between the child and the road.
cards.next_implementation_task: Give the inquiry a staged household discussion, branch-specific companion blocking and a final report assembled from heard and seen details.
cards.acceptance_criterion: Both inquiry routes reach a distinct acknowledgment, omitted evidence is not reported as seen, and restoring the checkpoint restores the companion and chosen route together.
cards.historical_basis: Original authored gameplay; historical setting does not authenticate the episode.

current_pass.limits: Procedural staging and original text; final animation, voice and cinematic art remain future work.

attention_increment.behavior: Existing evidence-led report gains a completion reflection without naming a culprit; optional replay remains separate from evidence.
attention_increment.verification: Focused native caption, scene, HUD and trace suites; inherited childhood arc, aftermath, courtyard, beginning and staging checks; native presentation inspection. See guide and PR #82 for exact results and limits.

narrative_direction.dramatic_question: Who gets to shape the account of an attack before the child has understood it himself?
narrative_direction.dramatic_turn: The family’s offer of protection becomes a question about who accompanies the child and how the child describes an uncertain event.
narrative_direction.setup_payoff: Revisit the ambush bend under altered circumstances. Identical ground becomes quieter evidence, and the optional guard changes its social meaning.
narrative_direction.playable_staging: Begin with Raj Kaur within ordinary household space, stage the escort beside rather than ahead of the player, and place the final report where both can be addressed.
narrative_direction.attention_pattern: Organize the arc as offer, return, observation and report. Present only the active decision, then release movement; keep the final account short enough to compare its sources.
narrative_direction.recovery: After reporting, allow a household response and a quiet return to available activities. Do not reveal a culprit merely to manufacture closure.
narrative_direction.agency: Escort and independent inquiry remain valid. The player determines which available testimony and physical evidence they actually obtain before reporting.
narrative_direction.acceptance: Both approaches reach a distinct acknowledgment; the report visibly separates heard and seen information, contains no absent evidence, and cannot be submitted through an obstructed or closed conversation.

cards.title: Four-food delivery

baseline.implementation: Implemented prototype on the recorded revision.
baseline.launch: Run game/project.godot; choose Home territory.
baseline.prerequisites: Completed inquiry; allowance/resources where required by the linked guide.

cards.dramatic_question: Can the young heir keep an ordinary promise when rank does not carry the food for him?
cards.playable_objective: Accept the four-food contract, collect its actual cargo and deliver it to the market recipient.
cards.encounter_or_choice: Decide whether to check the delivery terms with the household before setting off; the recipient responds to the real cargo rather than the player’s title.
cards.local_consequence: The existing finite payment remains attached to one successful handover; a failed attempt leaves a clear account of missing cargo.
cards.cinematic_moment: A busy market makes room for a small, practical exchange: a tally, a handover, and a recipient who returns immediately to work.
cards.next_implementation_task: Author a short contract briefing, show cargo and recipient spatially, and stage the single delivery acknowledgment.
cards.acceptance_criterion: Exactly four food leave the carried supply on success, payout occurs once, and save/load before or after handover cannot repeat the reward.
cards.historical_basis: Original authored gameplay; historical setting does not authenticate the episode.

narrative_direction.dramatic_question: Can the young heir keep an ordinary promise when rank does not carry the food for him?
narrative_direction.dramatic_turn: A task accepted under the heir’s name ends in an ordinary recipient checking whether the promise was kept.
narrative_direction.setup_payoff: The four-food tally at departure returns as the same tally at handover; the echo makes accountability visible without a speech about humility.
narrative_direction.playable_staging: Show cargo where it is collected and keep the recipient engaged in market work. The exchange briefly interrupts that work and then lets it resume.
narrative_direction.attention_pattern: Brief terms, free travel, one concrete inspection, one acknowledgment. Use a missing-cargo response only when the player attempts an incomplete handover.
narrative_direction.recovery: Leave space after payment for the market to resume. Do not turn a completed delivery into an immediate chain of new orders.
narrative_direction.agency: The player chooses the route and whether to confirm terms first; the recipient evaluates the actual delivery rather than choosing between flattering dialogue options.
narrative_direction.acceptance: A player can recall what was owed and recognize the same cargo at arrival; repeated interaction neither repeats the reward nor continually restates a finished objective.

current_pass.behavior: Four-portion briefing and matching handover acknowledgment; four visible carried parcels; active cargo guidance and local offered-action checks.
current_pass.literary_technique: A four-part visual tally makes an ordinary promise concrete; the recipient acknowledges the delivery rather than the heir’s rank.

cards.title: Bring the carrier Home

baseline.implementation: Implemented prototype on the recorded revision.
baseline.launch: Run game/project.godot; choose Home territory.
baseline.prerequisites: Completed inquiry; allowance/resources where required by the linked guide.

cards.dramatic_question: Does giving an escort order matter if the person entrusted to you cannot keep up?
cards.playable_objective: Meet the return carrier, keep physical contact during the journey, and check the same carrier and cargo into Home.
cards.encounter_or_choice: Stop and regroup when the carrier is separated or continue ahead and return to recover contact; the disputed crossing remains an optional route of this arc.
cards.local_consequence: Arrival is earned by the carrier’s physical return, with one existing supply check-in and no additional cargo for alternate paths.
cards.cinematic_moment: At the gate the child turns back; the laden carrier is still crossing the open road and the escort must wait.
cards.next_implementation_task: Add readable lost-contact and regroup behavior, an arrival blocking pass, and a shared handover used by the ordinary and disputed routes.
cards.acceptance_criterion: Reaching Home alone cannot finish; a separated carrier can be recovered, and every route resolves the same one-time check-in.
cards.historical_basis: Original authored gameplay; historical setting does not authenticate the episode.

narrative_direction.dramatic_question: Does giving an escort order matter if the person entrusted to you cannot keep up?
narrative_direction.dramatic_turn: The apparent finish at the gate reveals that arrival means bringing another person, not merely reaching a marker.
narrative_direction.setup_payoff: The carrier’s uneven pace introduced on departure pays off when the player must turn back or wait. The laden silhouette is the continuity cue across route variants.
narrative_direction.playable_staging: Use bends and the final gate to expose changing distance to the carrier. Keep the same carrier and load visible during regroup and check-in.
narrative_direction.attention_pattern: Alternate movement with short checks of companion position. Lost-contact guidance activates on separation, then subsides after reunion instead of becoming a constant escort alarm.
narrative_direction.recovery: A reunited carrier is allowed to catch breath; the final unload resolves the shared trip before any further supply request.
narrative_direction.agency: Choose pace and route, recover a separation, or use the disputed crossing. Waiting is a meaningful act of escort, not a hidden timer penalty.
narrative_direction.acceptance: A player who reaches Home alone understands whom to recover; ordinary and disputed routes conclude through the same physical check-in and one cargo receipt.

current_pass.behavior: Physical separation, reunion and arrival cues; one carrier and load; accepted check-in puts down the same cosmetic load; recoverable carrier guidance.
current_pass.literary_technique: An apparent finish at the gate becomes a decision to wait or return for the person entrusted to the player.

cards.title: Water for the household

baseline.implementation: Implemented prototype on the recorded revision.
baseline.launch: Run game/project.godot; choose Home territory.
baseline.prerequisites: Completed inquiry; allowance/resources where required by the linked guide.

cards.dramatic_question: Will the heir notice how much labor sits beneath the household’s ordinary comfort?
cards.playable_objective: Draw three units at the well twice, carry each load on foot, and return six units to the household.
cards.encounter_or_choice: The second trip makes the player choose a usable, steady route with the loaded carrier; waiting during the draw offers a short exchange with another household worker.
cards.local_consequence: Water accounting follows the real draw and deposits; conversation changes local acknowledgment without producing repeatable money.
cards.cinematic_moment: The well’s rope creaks against the rim, then the frame drops to the weight of the carried vessels on the walk back.
cards.next_implementation_task: Stage the draw and deposit as visible actions, add one concise worker exchange, and communicate load restrictions before the player tries to mount.
cards.acceptance_criterion: Two valid draws and deposits deliver exactly six units, load restrictions are explained in context, and interruption or reload cannot create water.
cards.historical_basis: Original authored gameplay; historical setting does not authenticate the episode.

narrative_direction.dramatic_question: Will the heir notice how much labor sits beneath the household’s ordinary comfort?
narrative_direction.dramatic_turn: The repeated water journey changes the well from background scenery into labor the household depends on.
narrative_direction.setup_payoff: Return to the same rope and vessels on the second trip, but let a short worker exchange change what the player notices about the repetition.
narrative_direction.playable_staging: Keep rope, filled vessels and household deposit visible at their actual interaction points; stage a passable walking route that reads differently under load.
narrative_direction.attention_pattern: Teach the first draw once. On the second, keep instructions compact and offer optional conversation during an existing pause rather than extending it.
narrative_direction.recovery: Finish on the settled vessels and worker acknowledgment. The player can leave without waiting through an extra ceremonial speech.
narrative_direction.agency: The player chooses a usable walking route and whether to listen; listening is not a prerequisite for the water’s practical value.
narrative_direction.acceptance: The second trip adds a changed human observation without replaying the full tutorial; six deposited units are visible in accounting and interrupted draws cannot duplicate water.

current_pass.behavior: Concise first-draw instruction, changed second-trip inner observation, live fill/deposit dialogue, visible vessel levels and contextual load guidance.
current_pass.literary_technique: Repetition with variation: the same road shifts from an errand to an awareness of everyday labor. The implemented voice is Buddh’s inner observation, not the planned worker exchange.

cards.dramatic_question: Can a promise to improve the household survive the cost and waiting that skilled work requires?
cards.playable_objective: Reserve fuel and fee, hand over the commission, return when the smith has finished, and deliver the two tools Home.
cards.encounter_or_choice: Before handover, commit the reserved resources or cancel openly; after handover, the smith gives an honest progress report rather than a second purchase.

narrative_direction.dramatic_question: Can a promise to improve the household survive the cost and waiting that skilled work requires?
narrative_direction.dramatic_turn: An attractive promise of new tools becomes an obligation to pay for time and skilled work.
narrative_direction.setup_payoff: The two unfinished blanks seen at commission return as the completed pair; the same workbench anchors reservation, work, and collection.

narrative_direction.dramatic_question: Can showmanship be disciplined enough to become a useful mounted skill?

narrative_direction.acceptance: A novice can state the current exercise without reading three instruction sets, retries preserve only earned capabilities, and standalone practice cannot write campaign rewards.

narrative_direction.dramatic_question: Can the young heir establish what happened to the remounts without treating suspicion as permission?
narrative_direction.dramatic_turn: Finding the horses offers visual certainty, but the sealed tally and the route of entry make the explanation less certain.
narrative_direction.setup_payoff: The gate first signifies exclusion and later becomes part of the witness account. The same two horses anchor evidence across all approaches.

narrative_direction.recovery: Provide an exit and a quiet walk to the quartermaster before the report so the player can distinguish discovery from inference.
narrative_direction.agency: Choose how to approach and which observations to secure; crossing a boundary does not automatically authorize confiscation or settle theft.

cards.title: The borrowed rope

baseline.implementation: Implemented prototype on the recorded revision.

cards.dramatic_question: What is owed to a story when two people remember its lesson differently?
cards.playable_objective: Hear the rope story’s variants, inspect the rope, compare the accounts, and retell a chosen version to a local listener.
cards.encounter_or_choice: Preserve one teller’s framing or openly name the disagreement; the physical rope can prompt recollection but cannot settle the story’s moral.
cards.local_consequence: The listener receives the selected attributed telling; the game stores transmission rather than declaring a canonical truth.
cards.cinematic_moment: The same length of rope passes through two different gestures as its tellers place emphasis on different parts of the memory.
cards.next_implementation_task: Stage each telling with a distinct voice and object handling, then add a concise retelling response that reflects the player’s chosen attribution.
cards.acceptance_criterion: The two accounts remain distinguishable, repeat listening adds no independent corroboration, and the listener receives only the retelling actually selected.
cards.historical_basis: Explicitly fictional sakhi-inspired transmission episode.

narrative_direction.dramatic_question: What is owed to a story when two people remember its lesson differently?
narrative_direction.dramatic_turn: A familiar object seems to promise a single answer until two tellers make different meanings from it.
narrative_direction.setup_payoff: The rope’s worn place becomes a repeated gesture, emphasized differently by each teller and recalled in the player’s final version.
narrative_direction.playable_staging: Place tellers in different ordinary tasks with access to the same rope. Let object handling show emphasis without a flashback claiming either account as objective truth.
narrative_direction.attention_pattern: Keep each telling short and distinct; allow comparison only after both have been heard. The final retelling asks for one clear emphasis rather than a memory quiz.
narrative_direction.recovery: Leave a pause after the listener’s response. The disagreement can remain alive without a corrective narrator entering to settle it.
narrative_direction.agency: Repeat a teller’s version with attribution or name the disagreement. Choosing what travels onward is the action, not solving the past.
narrative_direction.acceptance: A player can distinguish the two moral emphases and identify whose words were passed on; the saved transmission never upgrades either version into canonical fact.

cards.title: Lahore road patrol

cards.dramatic_question: How much authority can a ruler safely delegate before hearing what the road actually requires?
cards.playable_objective: Assign the patrol, control the captain or delegate the same order, inspect village and outpost, and receive the return report.
cards.encounter_or_choice: Organize the patrol or withdraw on the available observations; switching viewpoint changes control, not the number of orders or riders.
cards.local_consequence: Riders remain committed until the delayed report resolves the original order; the ruler learns only the report received.

narrative_direction.dramatic_question: How much authority can a ruler safely delegate before hearing what the road actually requires?
narrative_direction.dramatic_turn: An order that sounds simple at court becomes a road decision whose costs are carried by the assigned riders.
narrative_direction.setup_payoff: The same order phrase is heard at departure and qualified by the return report; the change in meaning comes from witnessed road conditions.
narrative_direction.playable_staging: Carry a recognizable patrol composition from court to village and outpost. Switching viewpoint keeps the order and committed riders continuous.
narrative_direction.attention_pattern: Give court one decision, the road one local dilemma, and return one bounded report. Avoid simultaneous strategic panels and urgent local action prompts.
narrative_direction.recovery: Allow a quiet return interval before the hearing. When delegated, the waiting ruler can act elsewhere without receiving the patrol’s unreported discoveries.
narrative_direction.agency: Control the captain or delegate, then organize or withdraw within available information. Viewpoint changes access, not the authority to duplicate orders.
narrative_direction.acceptance: Direct and delegated runs resolve the same original order and riders; the final report states its limits and cannot expose information the captain never acquired.

cards.playable_objective: Send scouts to ford and ridge, hear delayed reports, consult retainers, choose march or hold, and reach the fixed endpoint.
cards.encounter_or_choice: Spend time and provisions improving the account or advance with incomplete knowledge; bounded field orders change the immediate march, not the recorded death.
cards.local_consequence: The camp retains which reports arrived and which orders were issued; the father’s endpoint and chronology variant remain declared.
cards.cinematic_moment: A scout returns to find the same tent quieter; the last instruction carries farther than the father can now march.

narrative_direction.dramatic_question: What can a father still put in order when the campaign’s horizon is narrowing?
narrative_direction.dramatic_turn: The father’s command remains purposeful while his shrinking physical horizon makes each unfinished duty more intimate.
narrative_direction.setup_payoff: Repeat the ford and ridge names in preparation and arriving reports, then let the final handover refer to a duty actually addressed by the player.
narrative_direction.playable_staging: Keep the tent, provision point and returning scouts in a comprehensible camp. Changes in attendance and activity suggest the narrowing campaign without an omniscient death countdown.
narrative_direction.attention_pattern: Alternate one field decision with an actual delayed report. Give the final handover less interface noise and more time than a routine order, without disabling comprehension controls.
narrative_direction.recovery: After the last instruction, let the camp’s ordinary work carry the transition. Avoid a rapid reward montage after the fixed loss.
narrative_direction.agency: Choose what to learn, whether to march or hold, and how to use limited provisions. Immediate care matters even though the selected historical endpoint is fixed.
narrative_direction.acceptance: The player can connect the final handover to a completed or unresolved duty; missing reports stay missing, and no local choice silently changes the declared chronology or death.

cards.dramatic_question: What does a survivor choose to carry when an army’s crossing is gone?
cards.playable_objective: Escape the Sobraon earthworks, optionally carry a wounded soldier, steer timber across the Sutlej, and approach the later surrender tableau.
cards.encounter_or_choice: Take the wounded man and accept slower movement or move alone; steer through the river’s physical obstacles before the later oral telling.
cards.local_consequence: The immediate survival presentation remembers the rescue choice; the veteran’s later knowledge does not enter the child’s 1792 state.
cards.cinematic_moment: The roar of the river cuts to the heavy silence of dropped muskets, then an oral voice carries the image into family memory.
cards.next_implementation_task: Polish danger telegraphs, wounded-carry staging, timber feedback and the transition between the three times; keep the handoff to the family introduction explicit.

narrative_direction.dramatic_question: What does a survivor choose to carry when an army’s crossing is gone?
narrative_direction.dramatic_turn: The crossing’s destruction turns military defeat into a personal decision about who can be carried into the future telling.
narrative_direction.setup_payoff: The burden of the wounded soldier shapes the escape and the veteran’s later memory; river noise gives way to the silence of surrendered weapons.
narrative_direction.playable_staging: Keep near obstacles and viable water direction visible from the controlled survivor. Treat the later tableau as a distinct temporal frame before entering the child’s world.
narrative_direction.attention_pattern: Begin with a legible survival problem before wider spectacle. Present the rescue choice in a moment with enough room to understand it, then reserve reflective narration for the aftermath.
narrative_direction.recovery: Allow a substantial quiet transition after river survival; the oral voice begins when immediate steering danger has ended.
narrative_direction.agency: Carry the wounded man or move alone, then steer the timber. Rescue changes the physical burden and remembered presentation without deciding the battle’s outcome.
narrative_direction.acceptance: Players understand the rescue choice before committing, can still read river hazards under the selected route, and recognize the time shift without receiving later-era knowledge in 1792.

cards.playable_objective: Inspect the gifts, receive the delegate, escort the arrival, hear the rival messenger and return an account to the keeper.
cards.encounter_or_choice: Enter with visible ceremony or a quieter practical approach, then choose whom to alert about the rival message.
cards.local_consequence: The local arrival and final account reflect presentation and disclosure; the scene does not award the marriage or determine the bride’s life.
cards.cinematic_moment: Gift bearers pause at a threshold while a lone messenger waits just outside the procession’s rhythm.

narrative_direction.dramatic_question: Can a family alliance reach the doorway without becoming a public contest over who commands it?
narrative_direction.dramatic_turn: A celebratory arrival becomes fragile when a lone messenger interrupts its carefully arranged public meaning.
narrative_direction.setup_payoff: The gift bundle is first a promise of alliance, then an awkward thing held while adults negotiate who may speak.
narrative_direction.playable_staging: Stage the procession as a moving depth cue and the rival messenger as a still interruption near its threshold. Escort remains in the player’s hands.

narrative_direction.agency: Choose the approach and whom to alert. The bride’s life and the alliance’s ultimate success are outside this errand’s authority.
narrative_direction.acceptance: The messenger interrupts an already understandable arrival, both approaches remain physically complete, and the keeper’s response names the chosen disclosure without granting a marriage outcome.

cards.title: The Unequal Victory

baseline.implementation: Playable blockout adaptation; five beats; local branch outcomes.

baseline.launch: Run res://history/punjab_chiefs_home.tscn; reach story bench; T selects alliance.

cards.dramatic_question: Whose sacrifice disappears when a coalition begins to tell a single story of victory?
cards.playable_objective: Hear the grievance, help the wounded companion across the passage, challenge the announcement and decide where the remaining dressings go.
cards.encounter_or_choice: Give priority to public recognition or immediate relief; the companion’s passage makes the practical cost of either emphasis visible.
cards.local_consequence: The gathering’s local account and allocation of dressings differ; no choice rewrites the coalition’s campaign result.
cards.cinematic_moment: A victory announcement continues over the sound of a wounded companion stopping halfway across the crossing.
cards.next_implementation_task: Stage the wounded escort with pauses and acknowledgment, separate the announcer from the relief point, and make the final allocation visible in the scene.
cards.acceptance_criterion: The companion physically reaches the crossing marker, the selected dressings recipient is reflected in the ending, and recognition never erases the recorded political dispute.
cards.historical_basis: retrospective_family_account; The book records shifting Nakai, Sukerchakia and other chief relationships, the 1785 coalition after Jai Singh's 1783 seizure, and failed reconciliation. This local escort and honour dispute is invented to make those pressures playable.

narrative_direction.dramatic_question: Whose sacrifice disappears when a coalition begins to tell a single story of victory?
narrative_direction.dramatic_turn: A victory announcement sounds complete until the wounded companion’s interrupted crossing exposes what the celebration leaves out.
narrative_direction.setup_payoff: The same announcement is heard before and after the player encounters its omitted cost; the remaining dressings make recognition compete with immediate need.
narrative_direction.playable_staging: Let the speaker remain audible while the wounded companion pauses visibly in the passage. The player moves between ceremony and care rather than watching a narrated comparison.
narrative_direction.attention_pattern: Use one public claim, one personal interruption and one bounded allocation. Keep contextual faction exposition optional after the immediate escort need is understood.
narrative_direction.recovery: After the allocation, give the companion a small bodily response and let the gathering continue. Avoid a triumph sting for choosing whom to help.

narrative_direction.agency: Choose attribution and emphasis while protecting the witness. The scene asks what to circulate, not whom to convict.
narrative_direction.acceptance: All available register wordings preserve their information source, the attendant reaches shelter, and neither image nor saved state resolves affair, poison or matricide as fact.

narrative_direction.dramatic_question: How much can a threatened ruler offer before anyone on the other side is authorized to answer?

narrative_direction.agency: Choose the offered assurance and question the receiver’s remit; delivery remains possible without securing the desired protection.
narrative_direction.acceptance: Players understand what was offered and what was merely received; no map, reward or summary marks a fort transfer, British alliance or interception absent from the scene.
